prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there isn’t a single “best” AI video ad maker — the right one depends on your goals (spokesperson-style vs. templated social ads vs. repurposing), budget, and platforms. Below are the top contenders in 2024 and when to use each.

Top picks (quick summary)
- Synthesia — Best for polished AI presenters / human-like spokesperson videos and localization. Great if you want on‑screen “people” without actors. Paid plans; good enterprise features.
- HeyGen (Movio/HeyGen family) — Similar to Synthesia; strong avatar quality and easy dubbing/localization.
- InVideo — Best all-around for marketers who want fast, template-driven social ads with lots of stock assets and aspect-ratio presets. Affordable and fast.
- Pictory — Best for turning scripts or long-form content into multiple short ads; automatic captioning and clip extraction.
- VEED / Descript — Best for hands-on editing + AI features (auto-subtitles, overdub). Use if you need fine control over edits and voice.
- Runway — Best for advanced creative effects and generative visuals (background replacement, image-to-video, SFX) when you want standout visuals.
- Opus Clip / Vidyo.ai — Best for automatically creating short ad clips from longer videos for TikTok/Instagram/YouTube Shorts.
- Promo.com / Shakr — Best for scale and platform-optimized templates specifically aimed at social video advertising across channels.

How to choose (criteria)
- Format needs: short vertical (TikTok/IG Reels) vs horizontal (YouTube) — check aspect-ratio presets.
- Creative type: live-action presenters (Synthesia/HeyGen) vs templated stock-video ads (InVideo/Promo) vs generative visuals (Runway).
- Scale/personalization: need thousands of personalized ads? Look at Rephrase.ai / Shakr.
- Budget: InVideo, Pictory, VEED have lower-cost plans; Synthesia/Runway/enterprise solutions cost more.
- Language & voice: Synthesia/HeyGen/Pictory offer many languages and realistic TTS.
- Integrations & analytics: choose platform that links to ad accounts or creative analytics (VidMob, Shakr for performance optimization).

If you want a single recommendation
- For most marketers who need fast, high-quality social ads with templates and stock assets: try InVideo (or Promo) first.
- If you need realistic AI presenters and localized spoken ads: try Synthesia or HeyGen.
- If you have long-form content to repurpose into many short ads: try Pictory or Opus Clip.

Want help narrowing it down?
Tell me: budget, primary ad format (vertical/horizontal), whether you need AI presenters, and whether you’ll be repurposing long videos — I’ll recommend 1–2 best choices and the exact plan to start with.
